description: Jet 4 MDB (same Workspace): Part 1: db1 RW opened first, db2 ReadOnly (False, True) opened second; checks Updatable, held snapshot & dynaset on db2 across db1 INSERT+UPDATE (immediate, Move 0, Idle(dbRefreshCache), Requery, fresh snapshot), and blocked writes on db2 (Execute INSERT, dynaset Edit -> errors); closes db1 then db2. Part 2: reverse open order — dbRo opened first, dbRw opened second, dbRw INSERTs row 20, dbRo reads and attempts write. Keeps all pages at every step.
